summary: 45-year-old man took a short fall off a boulder while hiking off-trail on the northeast shore of Lake Haiyaha, injuring his ankle and unable to walk; he called the park communications center for help; rangers carried an inflatable raft to the scene, floated him across the lake, carried him a short distance to the designated trail, and transported him to the trailhead by horse.
location: Northeast shore of Lake Haiyaha, Rocky Mountain National Park
responding_agency: NPS Rocky Mountain National Park rangers
notes: NPS morning-report compendium entry dated 2013-08-01 (Thursday-verified); one of three simultaneous 2013-07-25 incidents.
